title: Joshua (Jeshua) the High Priest
lead: Joshua son of Jehozadak, called Jeshua son of Jozadak in Ezra and Nehemiah, was the high priest who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel and led the rebuilding of the altar and the Temple (Ezra 3:2; Haggai 1:1).

sections.b: Born into the exiled priestly family (his father Jehozadak was taken into exile in 586 BC, 1 Chronicles 6:15), Joshua is named with Zerubbabel in Haggai (1:1, 12, 14; 2:2, 4) and in Ezra (3:2; 5:2). Zechariah sees him in a vision with the Satan accusing and his filthy clothes replaced (Zechariah 3:1-5). Sirach praises him with Zerubbabel (Sirach 49:12).
